overview: This 206-page file traces U.S. and Allied management of Japanese currency, exchange rates, external assets, and occupation costs from 1945 to 1949. Policy papers sit alongside diplomatic correspondence, individual currency claims, Buenos Aires trusteeship accounts, and Japanese responses to Joseph Dodge’s stabilization proposals.
interest: The file pairs high-level occupation policy with individual claims and detailed accounts of former Japanese Embassy property.
